_comment: The plan each fixed-hour service runs when nobody has finalised one in this browser. Ships with the app, so every machine starts on the transport manager's finalised plans without importing anything. A choice finalised in a browser still wins there; Revert returns to this. The three Rotational slots are not listed on purpose: they follow src/rotation.json, the manager's nine group plans stepping one clock every Monday. Set 2026-09-30 from the Planner exports in Documents/Projects_Summer/Plans; checked 2026-10-01 against 9 am final, 7am Shift and Subulapuram Unit (identical).
